title: Installation
subtitle: Install qortex-resource-react (alpha)
description: React hooks for qortex-resource. Requires React 18+ and the core package.

callouts.title: Alpha
callouts.content: Install exact alpha versions. APIs may change before 1.0.

content: React bindings for qortex-resource. Installing this package pulls in `qortex-resource` automatically. React 18+ is a peer dependency.

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-resource-react@0.1.0-alpha.0

# yarn
yarn add qortex-resource-react@0.1.0-alpha.0

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-resource-react@0.1.0-alpha.0

# peer: react ^18.2 (qortex-resource is a dependency — installed for you)

sections.title: Imports
sections.content: Hooks come from the React package. Core helpers like `zodResolver` still import from `qortex-resource` (available after install).
